### Task detail

| Criterion | iOS | Android | Web |
|---|---|---|---|
| AC-task-detail-1 (ui): Task detail shows the task's title, status, priority, due date (or `taskDetail.noDueDate`), notes (or `taskDetail.noNotes`), and created and updated dates. | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| AC-task-detail-2: Choosing a status saves it with `updateTaskStatus` and shows the returned task; on failure the previous status comes back and `taskDetail.updateError` shows. | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| AC-task-detail-3 (ui): Delete asks for confirmation; confirming deletes the task with `deleteTask` and returns to Tasks without it, and cancelling keeps it. | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| AC-task-detail-4: While loading a progress indicator shows; a failed load shows the error state with Retry, and a 404 shows the not-found state. | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| AC-task-detail-5 (ui): Edit opens the Task editor filled in with this task. | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| AC-task-detail-6: When deleting fails, the user stays on Task detail and `taskDetail.deleteError` shows. | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |

### Task editor

| Criterion | iOS | Android | Web |
|---|---|---|---|
| AC-task-editor-1 (ui): New task opens the editor with an empty title, status To do, priority Medium and no due date. | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| AC-task-editor-2: Save is disabled while the trimmed title is empty or over 120 characters, or notes are over 2000, and the matching message shows. | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| AC-task-editor-3: Saving a new task sends the trimmed title, notes, status, priority and due date with `createTask`, then closes the editor. | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| AC-task-editor-4: Editing an existing task starts with its values, and saving sends the changes with `updateTask` and closes the editor. | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| AC-task-editor-5: Turning the due date on picks today's date; turning it off saves the task without a due date. | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| AC-task-editor-6: While saving, Save is disabled; when saving fails, `taskEditor.saveError` shows and every field keeps its value. | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| AC-task-editor-7 (ui): Cancel closes the editor without saving. | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |

### Tasks

| Criterion | iOS | Android | Web |
|---|---|---|---|
| AC-tasks-1 (ui): Tasks lists the server's tasks in the order received, each row showing its title, priority and status, and its due date when it has one. | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| AC-tasks-2: While the first load runs a loading indicator shows; when a load fails, the error state shows, and Retry loads again and shows the tasks. | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| AC-tasks-3: When there are no tasks and no filter is set, the empty state shows with a New task button. | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| AC-tasks-4: Choosing a status filter requests only tasks with that status (`status` on `listTasks`) and shows them; All requests every status. | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| AC-tasks-5: Choosing a priority filter requests only tasks with that priority (`priority` on `listTasks`), combined with the status filter. | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| AC-tasks-6: When a filter matches nothing, the filtered-empty state shows, and Clear filters resets both filters and shows every task. | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| AC-tasks-7 (ui): Tapping an open task's toggle marks it Done (and a Done task's toggle marks it To do) at once and saves it with `updateTaskStatus`. | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| AC-tasks-8: When saving a toggle fails, the row returns to its previous status and `tasks.updateError` shows. | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| AC-tasks-9: A task that isn't Done with a due date before today shows `task.overdue`; a Done task, or one due today or later, does not. | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| AC-tasks-10 (ui): Tapping a row opens that task's Task detail, and New task opens the Task editor for a new task. | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| AC-tasks-11 (ui): Tasks has an entry point that opens Settings. | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| AC-tasks-12: The tasks count caption shows the number of tasks in the list. | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
